description: Use for a decision on the user's concrete situation: returns the few decision rules from the CDO Agent know-how that apply to it, on software, integrations, data or connecting AI. For how to handle a type of situation call get_playbook first; to learn a topic use teach_delivery_topic. Describe the situation in plain text. Never paste files, credentials or customer data.

situation.description: The user's question in their own words, plus at most one sentence of facts they gave. Nothing that is unknown, no analysis.
